recipes.name: Feijoada Completa
recipes.description: Brazil's black-bean monument: beef-forward stew with rice, farofa and orange.

ingredients.name: Sides: Rice, Farofa, Orange Slices, Couve

steps.instruction: Soak/desalt beef overnight; parboil.
Simmer beans with meats 3h; mash some beans thick.
Onion-garlic oil sizzle folded in; serve full spread.

videos.videoTitle: FEIJOADA COMPLETA | Receita de Feijoada Tradicional Fácil e Prática

recipes.name: Bife à Rolê
recipes.description: Brazilian beef rolls stuffed with carrot-bacon-free greens, braised tomato-style.

ingredients.name: Carrot Sticks & Halal Smoke Strips & Onion Slivers

steps.instruction: Season, fill, roll tight, tie.
Brown all over.
Braise in tomato-stock 75 min till tender.

recipes.name: Escondidinho de Carne Seca
recipes.description: 'Hidden' shredded sunned beef under creamy cassava purée crust.

steps.instruction: Refogar onion-tomato; add beef shreds.
Layer beef / purée in dish.
Cheese top; bake 200°C 25 min golden.

videos.videoTitle: Aprenda a fazer o melhor Escondidinho de Carne Seca!

recipes.name: Strogonoff de Frango
recipes.description: Brazil's creamy ketchup-mushroom chicken stroganoff with shoestring potatoes.

steps.instruction: Sear chicken; mushrooms in.
Sauces in; simmer 10 min.
Cream off-boil; serve rice + palha.

videos.videoTitle: Brazilian Chicken Stroganoff Recipe | Estrogonofe de Frango

recipes.name: Bife na Manteiga
recipes.description: Pan-seared butter-basted steak with garlic and parsley.

steps.instruction: Pat steaks dry and season generously with salt and pepper on both sides.
Heat a cast-iron skillet over high heat, sear steaks in butter with crushed garlic for 3 minutes per side.
Baste continuously with foaming butter, scatter parsley, rest 5 minutes before slicing.

recipes.name: Carne Seca com Mandioca
recipes.description: Dried salted beef simmered until tender alongside boiled cassava root.

steps.instruction: Desalinate carne seca by soaking in cold water for 12 hours, changing water twice.
Simmer beef with onion, garlic, and bay leaves in fresh water until fork-tender, about 2 hours.
Peel and boil cassava separately until soft; serve sliced beef over cassava with cooking broth.

videos.videoTitle: CARNE SECA COM MANDIOCA DO CHEF TAICO

recipes.name: Picadinho de Carne
recipes.description: Hearty ground beef stew with potatoes, carrots, and green olives.

steps.instruction: Brown ground beef in a pot with diced onion and minced garlic until no longer pink.
Add diced potatoes, sliced carrots, tomato sauce, and 1 cup of water; simmer covered 25 minutes.
Stir in green olives, adjust seasoning, and serve over steamed white rice.

videos.videoTitle: PICADINHO DE CARNE, MUITO FÁCIL E PRÁTICO! TODAS AS DICAS PRA FICAR PERFEITO!

recipes.name: Estrogonofe de Carne
recipes.description: Brazilian beef stroganoff in a creamy mushroom and tomato sauce.

steps.instruction: Sear beef strips in hot oil until browned on all sides; set aside.
Sauté onion, garlic, and sliced mushrooms until golden, then add tomato sauce and simmer 5 minutes.
Return beef, pour in heavy cream, heat through without boiling, and garnish with potato sticks.

recipes.name: Fraldinha Grelhada
recipes.description: Thin-cut marinated flank steak char-grilled over open flame.

steps.instruction: Score the meat in a crosshatch pattern and marinate with crushed garlic, olive oil, lime, and oregano for 2 hours.
Grill over very high heat for 3 minutes per side until charred outside and medium-rare inside.
Rest 5 minutes, slice against the grain, and serve with vinagrete and white rice.

videos.videoTitle: FRALDINHA NA GRELHA | CHURRASCO DO FELIPE

recipes.name: Carne de Panela
recipes.description: Classic Brazilian pot roast with root vegetables braised in its own juices.

steps.instruction: Season the whole chuck roast with salt, pepper, and crushed garlic; let stand 30 minutes.
Sear meat in a heavy pot on all sides until deeply browned, then add onions and bay leaves.
Add water, cover tightly, and simmer on low heat for 2 hours; add vegetables in the last 40 minutes.

recipes.name: Bife a Cavalo
recipes.description: Brazilian skillet steak crowned with a runny egg and farofa.

steps.instruction: Pound steaks thin, season with garlic, salt, and pepper, and let absorb flavors for 20 minutes.
Pan-sear steaks in butter over high heat for 2 minutes per side; set aside on warm plates.
In the same pan, scramble eggs to a soft curd with manioc flour; spoon over steaks.

recipes.name: Alcatra com Cenoura
recipes.description: Slow-simmered beef chuck roast with carrots and aromatic spices.

steps.instruction: Tie the chuck roast with kitchen twine and season all over with salt, pepper, and garlic.
Brown on all sides in a heavy Dutch oven, then add sliced onions, bay leaves, and water.
Cover and simmer on low for 2.5 hours, adding sliced carrots in the last 45 minutes.

recipes.name: Carne Seca com Couve
recipes.description: Dried salted beef shredded and tossed with garlicky collard greens.

steps.instruction: Desalinate carne seca overnight in cold water, then boil until tender and shred by hand.
Slice collard greens into thin ribbons and set aside.
Sauté minced garlic and onion in olive oil, add shredded beef and pepper flakes, toss in collard greens until wilted.

recipes.name: Bife Rocambole
recipes.description: Butterflied beef roulade stuffed with hard-boiled eggs and herbs.

steps.instruction: Butterfly the beef and pound to an even thickness, then season with salt, pepper, and garlic.
Layer sliced hard-boiled eggs, diced carrots, onion, and parsley; roll tightly and secure with toothpicks.
Sear all sides in a hot pot, add a splash of water, cover, and simmer 45 minutes until cooked through.

recipes.name: Acém com Molho
recipes.description: Chuck beef simmered in a rich brown onion gravy until fork-tender.

steps.instruction: Cut beef into large chunks and brown well in a heavy pot on all sides.
Add sliced onions and minced garlic; cook until softened, then stir in tomato paste.
Pour in water, add bay leaves, cover, and simmer gently for 2 hours until meat shreds easily.

recipes.name: Carne Moída com Batata
recipes.description: Ground beef cooked with cubed potatoes in a savory tomato base.

steps.instruction: Brown ground beef in olive oil with diced onion and minced garlic, breaking into small pieces.
Add cubed potatoes and tomato sauce with half a cup of water; simmer covered for 20 minutes.
Season with salt and pepper, garnish with chopped parsley, and serve over rice.

recipes.name: Costela com Mandioca
recipes.description: Beef short ribs grilled and served alongside boiled cassava.

steps.instruction: Marinate ribs with crushed garlic, lime juice, olive oil, and salt for at least 2 hours.
Grill ribs over medium-high heat, turning every 5 minutes, for about 25 minutes total until charred.
Peel and boil cassava until tender; serve ribs on a wooden board with cassava on the side.

recipes.name: Peito de Boi com Legumes
recipes.description: Beef brisket slow-simmered with mixed seasonal vegetables.

steps.instruction: Season brisket with salt, pepper, and garlic; sear on all sides in a heavy pot until browned.
Add onion, bay leaves, and water; cover and simmer on low for 2 hours.
Add diced carrots and potatoes for 30 minutes, then zucchini for the final 10 minutes.

recipes.name: Lombo de Boi Grelhado
recipes.description: Grilled beef tenderloin medallions with chimichurri and roasted peppers.

steps.instruction: Cut tenderloin into thick medallions, season with salt and pepper, and bring to room temperature.
Grill over high heat for 3 minutes per side; rest on a warm plate for 5 minutes.
Make chimichurri by blending parsley, garlic, olive oil, and vinegar; grill peppers and serve alongside.

recipes.name: Creme de Abóbora
recipes.description: Velvety pumpkin cream soup with nutmeg and a swirl of cream.

steps.instruction: Sauté diced onion and garlic in butter until soft; add cubed pumpkin and cook 3 minutes.
Pour in vegetable broth, bring to a simmer, and cook covered for 20 minutes until pumpkin is very soft.
Blend until silky smooth, return to heat, stir in cream and nutmeg, adjust seasoning.

recipes.name: Galinhada
recipes.description: Saffron-yellow chicken-and-rice one pot from Goiás.

steps.instruction: Brown seasoned chicken with colorau.
Add rice + hot water; simmer covered 20 min.
Rest; peas + scallion finish.

recipes.name: Frango à Passarinho
recipes.description: Little-bird fried chicken bites with garlic and lime.

steps.instruction: Marinate 1h; dry well.
Fry 165°C ~14 min golden-cooked.
Toss garlic-lime-parsley butter.

recipes.name: Canja de Galinha
recipes.description: Chicken-rice healing soup, Brazilian penicillin.

steps.instruction: Poach chicken 40 min; skim.
Shred; add veg + rice; 20 min more.
Herb shower; serve with lime.

recipes.name: Frango com Quiabo
recipes.description: Chicken thighs stewed with sliced okra in a savory tomato broth.

steps.instruction: Season chicken thighs with salt, pepper, and garlic; brown on all sides in a deep pan.
Add diced onion, sliced okra, and tomato sauce with a cup of water; add bay leaves.
Cover and simmer on medium-low for 35 minutes until chicken is tender and okra is soft.

recipes.name: Frango com Palmito
recipes.description: Sliced chicken breast with hearts of palm in a light cream sauce.

steps.instruction: Slice chicken breast into strips and season with salt, pepper, and minced garlic.
Cook chicken in a skillet until golden; add diced onion and cook until translucent.
Add sliced hearts of palm and cream, simmer 5 minutes, and finish with chopped parsley.

recipes.name: Frango Cozido com Legumes
recipes.description: Whole chicken pieces stewed with root vegetables in a light herb broth.

steps.instruction: Season chicken pieces with salt, pepper, and garlic; brown lightly in a pot.
Add diced onion, sliced carrots, cubed potatoes, bay leaves, and water.
Simmer covered for 40 minutes until chicken and vegetables are tender; garnish with parsley.

recipes.name: Peito de Frango Grelhado
recipes.description: Marinated grilled chicken breast with lime and fresh herbs.

steps.instruction: Marinate chicken breasts with lime juice, crushed garlic, olive oil, oregano, and salt for 1 hour.
Preheat grill or grill pan to high; cook chicken 5 minutes per side until internal temp reaches 75°C.
Rest 3 minutes, slice on the bias, and serve with a simple green salad.

recipes.name: Frango ao Molho Pardo
recipes.description: Chicken pieces braised in a deep caramelized onion brown sauce.

steps.instruction: Season chicken with salt, pepper, and garlic; brown deeply in a heavy pot.
Add thinly sliced onions and cook until deeply caramelized, about 15 minutes.
Return chicken, add soy sauce, bay leaves, and water; cover and simmer 40 minutes.

recipes.name: Frango com Creme de Leite
recipes.description: Creamy Brazilian chicken in a rich milk cream and tomato sauce.

steps.instruction: Slice chicken into strips, season, and sear in a hot pan until golden; set aside.
Sauté diced onion and garlic until translucent; add tomato sauce and cook 3 minutes.
Return chicken, pour in cream, stir gently until heated through, and finish with parsley.

recipes.name: Frango com Milho
recipes.description: Chicken thighs simmered with sweet corn kernels in a savory broth.

steps.instruction: Brown chicken thighs in a pot with salt and pepper until golden on both sides.
Add diced onion, minced garlic, and tomato sauce; cook 3 minutes.
Pour in water and corn kernels; simmer covered for 30 minutes until chicken is cooked through.

recipes.name: Frango com Abobrinha
recipes.description: Chicken breast sautéed with zucchini and garlic in olive oil.

steps.instruction: Dice chicken breast and season with salt, pepper, and minced garlic.
Cook in olive oil over medium-high heat until golden, then add sliced zucchini.
Sauté together for 6 minutes until zucchini is just tender; finish with lemon juice and parsley.

recipes.name: Frango com Cenoura
recipes.description: Chicken drumsticks braised with carrots and onion.

steps.instruction: Season drumsticks with salt, pepper, garlic, and a drizzle of olive oil.
Brown in a pot, then add sliced carrots, diced onion, bay leaves, and water.
Cover and simmer for 35 minutes until chicken is cooked through and carrots are soft.

recipes.name: Frango com Chuchu
recipes.description: Chicken pieces braised with chayote squash in a light broth.

steps.instruction: Brown seasoned chicken pieces in a pot until golden on all sides.
Add diced onion, garlic, tomato sauce, and cubed chayote with water.
Cover and simmer for 30 minutes until chayote is tender and chicken is cooked through.

recipes.name: Frango com Leite de Coco
recipes.description: Chicken simmered in fragrant coconut milk with lime and cilantro.

steps.instruction: Season chicken with garlic, ginger, salt, and pepper; brown in a hot pot.
Pour in coconut milk and add sliced red pepper; bring to a gentle simmer.
Cook covered for 35 minutes; finish with lime juice and fresh cilantro before serving.

recipes.name: Frango com Batata
recipes.description: Chicken pieces roasted with cubed potatoes and onions.

steps.instruction: Season chicken with salt, pepper, paprika, and crushed garlic; let rest 20 minutes.
Toss cubed potatoes and onion wedges in olive oil; spread in a roasting pan with chicken pieces.
Cover and cook over moderate heat for 50 minutes, turning once halfway through.

recipes.name: Frango com Ervilha
recipes.description: Diced chicken breast sautéed with green peas and carrots.

steps.instruction: Dice chicken and season with salt, pepper, and garlic; sear in a hot pan.
Add diced carrots and cook 3 minutes, then add peas and tomato sauce.
Simmer together for 10 minutes until chicken is cooked through and vegetables are tender.

recipes.name: Frango com Brócolis
recipes.description: Sliced chicken breast with broccoli florets in garlic sauce.

steps.instruction: Slice chicken breast into strips and season with salt, pepper, and minced garlic.
Cook in olive oil until golden, then add blanched broccoli florets.
Toss together for 3 minutes, finish with lemon juice, and serve immediately.

recipes.name: Frango com Mandioca
recipes.description: Chicken thighs simmered with chunks of cassava in a savory broth.

steps.instruction: Brown seasoned chicken thighs in a pot until golden on all sides.
Add diced onion, garlic, bay leaves, peeled cassava chunks, and water.
Simmer covered for 40 minutes until cassava is soft and chicken is cooked through.

recipes.name: Frango com Abóbora
recipes.description: Chicken pieces stewed in a sweet pumpkin sauce with herbs.

steps.instruction: Season chicken with salt, pepper, cumin, and garlic; brown in a heavy pot.
Add cubed pumpkin, diced onion, and water; bring to a simmer.
Cover and cook for 35 minutes until pumpkin is soft and chicken is tender; mash some pumpkin into the sauce.

recipes.name: Purê de Mandioca
recipes.description: Velvety mashed cassava enriched with butter and fresh herbs.

steps.instruction: Peel cassava, remove the fibrous core, and cut into chunks.
Boil in salted water until very tender, about 25 minutes; drain well.
Mash with butter and warm milk until smooth; fold in minced garlic and chopped parsley.

recipes.name: Picanha na Brasa
recipes.description: Fat-capped rump skewered, rock-salted, carved pink off the churrasco.

steps.instruction: Salt heavily just before fire.
Grill fat-side first; slice outer layer 'pastel', return rest.
Serve thin with vinagrete + farofa.

recipes.name: Pão de Queijo
recipes.description: Gluten-free tapioca cheese puffs, chewy-hot from oven.

steps.instruction: Scald starch with hot milk-oil; cool slightly.
Beat in eggs + cheese to sticky dough.
Ball; bake 200°C ~22 min puffed hollow.

videos.videoTitle: PÃO DE QUEIJO MINEIRO DE VERDADE❗😍 CROCANTE POR FORA, MOLINHO POR DENTRO E NÃO MURCHA!

recipes.name: Moqueca de Palmito
recipes.description: Hearts-of-palm coconut-dende stew - vegetarian moqueca pride.

steps.instruction: Layer marinated veg + palmito in clay pot.
Coconut milk; simmer covered 25 min.
Dendê swirl + coriander + lime at end.

recipes.name: Quibebe
recipes.description: Silky spiced pumpkin stew, Bahian comfort side-star.

steps.instruction: Sweat aromatics; pumpkin + splash water.
Cover-stew 25 min; mash partially creamy.
Oil swirl + herbs.

recipes.name: Cuscuz Paulista (Vegetarian)
recipes.description: Molded cornmeal terrine studded with vegetables, eggs and peas.

ingredients.name: Peas, Carrot, Palm hearts, Boiled Eggs, Olives

steps.instruction: Decor-line oiled mold with egg/veg.
Cook cornmeal into thick porridge with stock/passata + fillings.
Pack mold; chill 3h; unmold.

recipes.name: Lagarto Recheado
recipes.description: Stuffed eye of round roast with carrots, olives, and herbs.

steps.instruction: Butterfly the roast lengthwise and pound flat; season with garlic, salt, and pepper.
Spread diced carrots, sliced olives, and chopped egg across the meat; roll and tie securely.
Sear in a hot pot, add bay leaves and a cup of water, cover, and roast at moderate heat for 90 minutes.

recipes.name: Arroz com Feijão
recipes.description: The cornerstone of the Brazilian table: fluffy white rice with creamy black beans.

steps.instruction: Rinse rice and sauté with minced garlic and olive oil until grains are coated; add water and cook covered 18 minutes.
Soak beans overnight, then simmer with bay leaves, onion, and garlic until creamy, about 1.5 hours.
Fluff rice, ladle beans alongside, and drizzle with olive oil.

recipes.name: Vinagrete Brasileiro
recipes.description: Bright diced tomato, onion, and pepper vinaigrette served alongside grilled meats.

steps.instruction: Dice tomatoes, onion, and bell pepper into uniform small cubes.
Toss together in a bowl with white vinegar, olive oil, and chopped parsley.
Season with salt and let marinate at least 15 minutes before serving.

recipes.name: Salada Brasileira
recipes.description: Fresh mixed green salad with hearts of palm and cherry tomatoes.

steps.instruction: Wash and dry lettuce, tear into bite-sized pieces, and arrange on a platter.
Slice hearts of palm into rounds, halve cherry tomatoes, and thin-slice red onion.
Scatter over lettuce, drizzle with olive oil and lime juice, season with salt and pepper.

recipes.name: Couve com Alho
recipes.description: Thinly sliced collard greens sautéed with garlic and olive oil.

steps.instruction: Remove tough stems from collard greens, stack leaves, and slice into very thin ribbons.
Heat olive oil in a wide pan and cook minced garlic until fragrant but not browned.
Add collard green ribbons and toss over high heat for 2 minutes until bright green and just wilted.

recipes.name: Mandioca Cozida
recipes.description: Boiled cassava root served with garlic butter and fresh herbs.

steps.instruction: Peel cassava, remove the fibrous core, and cut into large chunks.
Boil in salted water for 20-25 minutes until completely tender when pierced with a fork.
Drain, toss with minced garlic, olive oil, and chopped parsley while still hot.

recipes.name: Cuscuz de Milho
recipes.description: Steamed Brazilian corn cake with a moist, slightly sweet crumb.

steps.instruction: Blend corn kernels with coconut milk until smooth; mix with cornmeal, sugar, and salt.
Pour batter into a greased ring mold or deep pan.
Cover tightly and steam over simmering water for 45 minutes until set and firm to the touch.

recipes.name: Pamonha de Milho
recipes.description: Sweet fresh corn tamale wrapped and steamed in corn husks.

steps.instruction: Grate corn kernels and blend with coconut milk, sugar, butter, and salt into a thick batter.
Soak corn husks in warm water until pliable; spoon batter into each pair of overlapping husks.
Fold husks into packets, tie securely, and simmer in water for 40 minutes until firm.

recipes.name: Canjica com Leite de Coco
recipes.description: White hominy kernels slow-simmered in sweet coconut milk with cinnamon.

steps.instruction: Soak hominy overnight in cold water, then drain and rinse thoroughly.
Simmer hominy in water with cinnamon sticks for 1.5 hours until kernels are very soft.
Add coconut milk and sugar, cook 20 more minutes until thick and creamy, stir in shredded coconut.

recipes.name: Angu com Molho
recipes.description: Smooth cornmeal mush served with a simple tomato-onion sauce.

steps.instruction: Bring salted water to a boil, slowly whisk in cornmeal, and stir constantly until thickened, about 8 minutes.
Pour into a greased dish and let set for 10 minutes.
Make sauce by sautéing onion and garlic, adding diced tomatoes, and cooking until saucy; serve over angu.

recipes.name: Arroz Tropeiro
recipes.description: Farmer-style rice cooked with beans, collard greens, and garlic.

steps.instruction: Cook beans until tender with bay leaf and garlic; reserve some cooking liquid.
Sauté diced onion and minced garlic in olive oil; add rice and toast for 2 minutes.
Add beans, thinly sliced collard greens, and bean broth; cover and cook until rice is fluffy.

recipes.name: Creme de Milho
recipes.description: Rich and creamy sweet corn soup finished with butter and cream.

steps.instruction: Sauté diced onion and garlic in butter until translucent; add corn kernels and cook 3 minutes.
Add water and simmer for 15 minutes; blend until completely smooth.
Return to heat, stir in cream, adjust seasoning, and serve hot with a drizzle of olive oil.

recipes.name: Abóbora com Canela
recipes.description: Pumpkin wedges gently simmered with cinnamon and a touch of sugar.

steps.instruction: Peel pumpkin, remove seeds, and cut into thick wedges.
Arrange in a single layer in a wide pan with butter, sugar, cinnamon, and a splash of water.
Cover and cook on low heat for 20 minutes, turning once, until tender and caramelized.

recipes.name: Feijão Tropeiro
recipes.description: Hearty beans with manioc flour, collard greens, garlic, and olives.

steps.instruction: Cook beans until tender but not mushy; drain and reserve the cooking liquid.
Sauté garlic in olive oil, add sliced collard greens and cook until wilted.
Toss hot beans with the garlicky greens, fold in manioc flour and olives until evenly combined.

recipes.name: Tapioca de Coco
recipes.description: Crispy tapioca crepe filled with sweet shredded coconut.

steps.instruction: Sift tapioca flour to remove lumps and ensure a fine, even powder.
Heat a non-stick pan over medium heat, sprinkle flour in an even circle, and cook until edges lift.
Fill with sweetened shredded coconut, fold in half, and cook until lightly golden on each side.

recipes.name: Brigadeiro
recipes.description: Fudgy chocolate-condensed milk truffles rolled in sprinkles.

steps.instruction: Stir all over medium till pan-revealing (~10 min).
Chill till handleable.
Buttered hands roll balls in sprinkles.

recipes.name: Pudim de Leite Condensado
recipes.description: Wobbling condensed-milk flan with deep amber caramel.

steps.instruction: Caramel the mold.
Blend custard smooth (no foam); strain.
Water bath 170°C ~65 min; chill; invert.

videos.videoTitle: Como fazer PUDIM DE LEITE CONDENSADO TRADICIONAL

recipes.name: Quindim
recipes.description: Glossy golden coconut and egg yolk custard with a caramelized bottom.

steps.instruction: Whisk egg yolks with sugar until pale and thick; stir in coconut milk, melted butter, and vanilla.
Fold in shredded coconut and pour into greased individual molds.
Bake in a water bath until set with a glossy top and caramelized base, about 45 minutes; chill 4 hours.

recipes.name: Cocada Branca
recipes.description: Chewy white coconut candy made with condensed milk and sugar.

steps.instruction: Dissolve sugar in water over medium heat, stirring until it forms a light syrup.
Add shredded coconut and condensed milk; stir continuously until mixture pulls away from the pan.
Pour into a greased tray, score into squares while warm, and let cool completely before removing.

recipes.name: Ambrosia de Leite
recipes.description: Silky condensed milk custard dusted with cinnamon.

steps.instruction: Whisk condensed milk with egg yolks and vanilla until smooth.
Cook in a non-stick pan over low heat, stirring constantly, until thick and pulling away from the sides.
Pour into individual ramekins, refrigerate for 3 hours, and dust with cinnamon before serving.

recipes.name: Mousse de Maracujá
recipes.description: Tangy passion fruit mousse lightened with whipped cream.

steps.instruction: Bloom gelatin in cold water, then dissolve in warm passion fruit juice.
Whip heavy cream to soft peaks; fold in condensed milk and passion fruit mixture gently.
Divide into glasses, refrigerate for at least 4 hours until firmly set.

recipes.name: Arroz Doce Brasileiro
recipes.description: Creamy Brazilian rice pudding with cinnamon and condensed milk.

steps.instruction: Rinse rice and simmer in milk with cinnamon sticks and lemon zest over very low heat for 40 minutes.
Stir in condensed milk and sugar; continue stirring gently for 10 minutes until thick and creamy.
Serve warm or chilled, dusted generously with ground cinnamon.

recipes.name: Canjica Doce
recipes.description: Sweet hominy pudding slow-cooked in cinnamon-spiked coconut milk.

steps.instruction: Soak hominy overnight; drain and simmer in water with cinnamon sticks until kernels are very soft.
Add coconut milk, condensed milk, and sugar; cook over low heat for 30 minutes, stirring often.
Stir in shredded coconut, ladle into bowls, and serve warm with a dusting of cinnamon.

recipes.name: Manjar de Coco
recipes.description: Coconut milk pudding unmolded and drizzled with caramelized molasses.

steps.instruction: Dissolve cornstarch in coconut milk with sugar and a pinch of salt; whisk until smooth.
Cook over medium heat, stirring constantly, until very thick and pulling from the pan sides.
Pour into a bundt mold, chill 4 hours until firm; unmold and serve with warm molasses drizzled over.

recipes.name: Bolo de Cenoura
recipes.description: Moist Brazilian carrot cake topped with a glossy chocolate glaze.

steps.instruction: Blend carrots, eggs, sugar, and oil until completely smooth; fold in flour and baking powder.
Pour into a greased bundt pan and bake at 180°C for 35 minutes until a skewer comes out clean.
Melt chocolate with cream for the glaze; pour over cooled cake and let set before slicing.
